results.title: Where is Super Bowl 2027? Location, date for future NFL championships, including 2030 in Nashville - CBS Sports
results.content:
Of all states, Florida has hosted the most Super Bowls at 17, followed by California at 12 and Louisiana at 11.

The two cities to host the most Super Bowls are Miami, Florida, and New Orleans, Louisiana, which both hosting 11. Super Bowl 59 in 2025 at the Caesars Superdome marked New Orleans' 11th time hosting. The 2020 Super Bowl at Hard Rock Stadium was Miami's 11th time hosting. [...] Just a few months ago, the Seattle Seahawks were crowned Super Bowl 60 champions, after defeating the New England Patriots 29-13. The 60th edition of the big game took place at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California. It was second Super Bowl played at the stadium, home of the San Francisco 49ers, and the third played in the San Francisco Bay area. [...] The Super Bowl has taken place in numerous cities and stadiums in its 60-year history and any area who wants to host must submit a proposal years in advance. The NFL owners vote on the city they want to select a few years before the game is scheduled. For instance, the 2028 game has already been awarded to Atlanta's Mercedes-Benz Stadium. In the beginning of the game's existence, the process was not as democratic or transparent.
